metaTitle: Custom Plastic Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom plastic badge ID holders in bulk. Perfect for events, offices, and trade shows. Get a quote from Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Plastic badge ID holders offer a durable, lightweight solution for daily badge use. Unlike fabric or metal holders, plastic resists bending and moisture, making them ideal for high-traffic environments like trade shows or manufacturing floors. Choose from clear or translucent styles to keep IDs visible, and add your logo with screen printing or a full-color insert. Options like the Tradeshow Badgeholder or Easy Slide ID Holder provide quick badge access for employees and attendees alike.
heroAltText: Stack of custom plastic badge ID holders with lanyards, featuring clear plastic and printed logo inserts.
